Subject: New supplier: Redwood Inference — initial vendor setup

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for speaking with our sourcing team this morning. Finance needs a quick vendor setup so we can route an initial PO to Redwood for the pilot engagement. High-level asks from AP:

- Supplier legal name and tax identifier (TIN/VAT)
- Remit-to banking instructions (for wire/ACH)
- Required PO fields (any mandatory internal fields we must include so the invoice will match)
- Preferred invoice PDF layout and remit address

Can you also confirm whether Redwood can accept Net 30 and whether you have a UK/EU VAT registration we should use for invoicing? We have a brief supplier form attached to this thread for your completion.

If you can send the completed form + bank details, our AP team will add you as a supplier and issue a test PO (we'll share the PO number).

Thanks —
Marta
Marta Sanchez
Sr. AP Manager, Acme Corporation

Hi Marta —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. I've attached our AP onboarding packet (Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf) which has the information you requested. Quick summary below:

- Supplier legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- US Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
- EU VAT: Redwood Inference, VAT ID GB999999999 (we rely on marketplace/partner billing in some EU regions; please let me know if you need a local fiscal rep)
- Remit-to (wire): Redwood Inference, Bank of West — Routing: 123456789, Account: 987654321 (full bank instruction document attached separately when we finalize)
- Invoice remit address: Redwood Inference, Attn: AP, 420 Redwood Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107

Mandatory PO fields we ask for (so our matching won't fail):
- PO number (field: PO_NO) — must be present on the invoice PDF
- Line-level descriptions with unit price and qty (we match at line-item level)
- Supplier ID (optional but helps — your system-assigned supplier id once created)
- Invoice date and invoice number
- Tax amount separate from line totals (if VAT is included, specify VAT rate per line)

Payment terms: Net 30 by default for pilot invoices. We can accept that. If Acme requires different terms for vendor onboarding (e.g., Net 45), advise and we can escalate.

I've also completed the supplier form you attached and am returning it here (see Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf). If you prefer a secure upload link, send it and we'll upload directly.

Next steps I'd propose:
1) Acme adds Redwood as supplier in your portal and shares Supplier ID.
2) Acme issues a test PO (we recommend a low-value PO to validate routing and matching).
3) We submit an invoice referencing that PO and confirm it clears to the right ledger and payment profile.

Let me know if you need a signed W-9 or additional tax docs — I can attach today.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

HI Naomi,

Thanks — that is helpful. We've created a preliminary supplier record and attached our intake form for your records (Acme_Supplier_Form.pdf). A couple of AP-specific items to note before we issue the test PO:

- Required PO fields (internal mapping): Supplier ID (assigned after onboarding), PO number, PO date, Buyer code, GL code (our finance mapping), Remit-to address, Tax ID.
- For EU invoices: if the service is B2B and subject to reverse charge, please include the phrase "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient" and supply your VAT ID on the invoice.
- Forms we need completed: W-9 (US vendors) or relevant EU VAT certificate. For non-US legal entities we also request a copy of the official registration.
- Portal: I'll send a supplier portal invite to the email you listed; once you accept, please upload the W-9 + bank instructions there. Attaching our standard intake for reference.

Portal invite: https://suppliers.acme-corp.com/invite?id=Z8xQf

I'll hold issuing the test PO until the portal upload is complete. Once you upload, reply to this thread and we will push the PO (expect format ACME-YYYY-XXXXX).

Best,
Marta
